Google LLC — Software Engineer (SWE)
Role Overview
Design, develop, test, and maintain large-scale distributed systems.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and implement backend services and APIs
• Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and participate in code review
• Take part in system design discussions

What We're Looking For
• Strong grasp of data structures and algorithms
• Working knowledge of operating systems fundamentals (processes, threads, virtual memory)
• Experience with object-oriented design and common design patterns
• Comfort reasoning about system design at scale
• Clear written and verbal communication
